messages.subject: Stan Math v2.9.0 has been tagged
parts:
I'm in the process of tagging Stan v2.9.0.



Bob, whatever branches you're working on, don't merge develop into them. I'll help you get whatever you need merged.

Submodules may go a little wacky and not track through the tagging, but I'm hoping it does.



Daniel
